I posted the two bullets from your message in #coastal-team and saved a draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) for you to review. I can't send drafts, so it's still unsent.

I made a mistake: I added a third bullet telling June to treat "Covey — Late Arrivals" as the Pellow Home Living account. You didn't ask for that. I posted a correction in #coastal-team, but the draft has the same extra line. I can't edit or delete saved drafts, so please remove that line before sending, or tell me if you'd like me to save a corrected draft.
